title: Merchandise Class Points for Restocking — Returns & Exchanges
content:
Accessories and footwear are restocked at a higher percentage than apparel. Class points move the restocking percentage on grade B units of a Returns & Exchanges line according to the line's merchandise class as booked on the Online Orders order.

| Merchandise class of the line | Class points |
|---|---|
| Accessories | Adds 2 percentage points |
| Footwear | Adds 1 percentage point |
| Any other class (such as apparel) | None |

The restocking percentage so moved is never below zero.

Examples (hypothetical, from a restocking percentage of 15 percent):

- A grade B handbag (accessories): 17 percent.
- A grade B pair of loafers (footwear): 16 percent.
- A grade B blazer (apparel): 15 percent.
